'''Voltreaver''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Voltverine]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "In search of the hero from years ago, Voltreaver has become one in the eyes of many young Tatari. Shredding your way through [[Zobos]] while staying humble is exactly what a true hero does."

Voltreaver is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Voltreaver was added to the game on 4/8/2026 alongside [[Weaverfang]] and [[Chrysolaria]].
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "A vigilante impossible to track down among these city ruins. Sometimes seen with [[Pyroclobster]] to rescue human under attack from Zobos."
